subject: general
question: Which of the following novels is NOT written by Amitav Ghosh?
solution:
The correct answer is__** A Suitable Boy.**__

__***Key Points__**

__
 
• A Suitable Boy* is a novel by Vikram Seth, published in 1993. With 1,349 pages (1,488 pages in paperback), the English–language book is one of the longest novels published in a single volume.
 
• The average reader will spend 24 hours and 48 minutes reading this book at 250 WPM (words per minute).
 
• ** **A Suitable Boy is set against India's newfound independence, and although the plot, including Lata and the other three families, is **not based on one true story**, the historical backdrop is accurate.
 
• 'A Suitable Boy' **remains a must-read**. Despite it being published almost three decades ago, 'A Suitable Boy' still never fails to impress its modern readers.
 
• Moreover, it was recently adapted into a BBC miniseries that garnered worldwide attention and admiration.

***Additional Information__**

 
• **The Circle of Reason is the first novel by Indian writer Amitav Ghosh. It was published in 1986.**
 
• **Sea of Poppies*** (2008) is a novel by Indian novelist **Amitav Ghosh** which was **shortlisted for the Man Booker Prize in 2008.**
 
• ***The Shadow Lines*** (1988) is a **Sahitya Akademi Award-winning novel** by Indian writer Amitav Ghosh.
